name_reason: Already compliant: fd2_ prefix + descriptor (play_figani_char_intro_animation), no Ghidra address residue. Descriptor accurately captures what the body does: play the FIGANI (figure-animation) per-character full-screen pose/reveal sequence. The 'intro' vocabulary is consistent with the sibling step it calls (fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim); the codebase uniformly names this full-screen FIGANI pose reveal the 'char intro' animation. The fact that its live trigger is a long-range caster spotlight (not literally a chapter intro) is a documentation nuance now captured in the comment/plate, not a naming defect. Rename would also ripple through protos.h and the sole caller for no semantic gain.
purpose: Play the FIGANI per-character full-screen intro/spotlight pose animation (silhouette flash, terrain backdrop, zoom-in pose, then per-pose FIGANI frame loop with hooked SFX) for one runtime char; sole live use is the caster spotlight just before a long-range AI item/spell strike.
logic_summary: Setup: NULL the spotlight bg ptr; read caster's portrait_id; free large_game_state_buffer + battle_scene_snapshot (snapshot also NULLed); malloc a 64000-byte mode-13h dst scratch and a 0x1F400 work buffer; memset dst; read tile attribute under caster's grid pos. Load resources via fd2_load_dat_resource: TAI.DAT[3] -> name-banner sprite (ptr_00); FIGANI.DAT[portrait_id*3] -> silhouette/skeleton sprite (ptr_01); FIGANI.DAT[portrait_id*3+1] -> animation byte stream (figani_buf); BG.DAT[tile_attr[6]] -> spotlight terrain backdrop; fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank(figani_buf) -> SFX bank. Reveal: fade to black, flash silhouette on backdrop, RLE-blit terrain into dst, zoom pose in via fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim. Per-pose loop over figani_buf[0] poses: frame_entry = figani_buf + *(int*)(figani_buf+8+i*4); if frame_entry[+5]!=0 play that SFX; restore backdrop into work buf, composite this pose, push work buf to VGA (0xA0000), hold frame_entry[+6] BIOS ticks. Cleanup: free all scratch + loaded resources; realloc large_game_state_buffer (0x25680); reload battle_scene_snapshot from FDSHAP.DAT indexed by tile_event_data_table[0]*2; settle 6 ticks; fade to black; clear VGA; recomposite battle frame; stop all FIGANI SFX (handle -1); free SFX bank if non-NULL; fade in.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Runtime-char array index of the caster whose FIGANI intro/spotlight pose is played (indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; used to read portrait_id, grid pos_x/pos_y, and passed to fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite / fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim). The sole caller passes its caster_idx.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is generic param_1. The src already declares this parameter as char_idx, which matches its runtime-char-index semantics and the sibling-function naming; align Ghidra to char_idx in Stage 2 (recorded only, not applied here).

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are entirely on-screen animation plus heap/global buffer lifecycle (re-establishes large_game_state_buffer and battle_scene_snapshot on exit).

data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr (0x53A55) - [0] used as FDSHAP.DAT reload index
data_fd2_audio_figani_sfx_bank_buf_ptr (0x54117) - read for SFX playback / free

data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot (0x53A5D) - NULLed at start, reloaded from FDSHAP.DAT at end
